g.text: API Gateway: One Entry Point for Every Client
Cross-cutting concerns handled once, before any backend request happens
Gateway checks: token valid, 43/100 req this minute, path matches /api/orders/* -> Orders Service
Orders Service receives: GET /orders/123 X-User-Id: 4521 (no re-auth needed)
(client -> service, at the edge). This is
what an API gateway is for.
This pair talking directly is east-west
